source: Yominet eth_getTransactionReceipt, recorded 2026-10-04 during a live test session on the public test account (operator 0x9b95d574d9a134d3ede3509f7f6dd008e7c1f6e5, owner/account 0xb6278e6c4d6f67e721f104db07ccbf1f4e9cfc47). Gas token 0xE1Ff7038eAAAF027031688E1535a055B2Bac2546.
synthetic: Two receipts are another account's: system_item_transfer_synthetic (another account sends 5 of item 11301 to the test account) and system_erc20_portal_claim_synthetic (the first live portal claim, 2026-10-04 — the 4.1.0 fix's evidence). In those two the other account's wallet addresses are replaced by 0xac00...01 / 0xac00...02, and the transaction hash, block hash and block number by synthetic values. Every other byte — values, topics, log order — is the chain's.
harvest_payouts_note: Chain truth read at the blocks: the account's item-2 balance went 61,952 (+2 by the 34031314 stop) -> 61,954; the two 34031315 stops paid 2 each (61,956 / 61,958); the 34031872 stops paid 622 and 630 (62,583 then 63,213) — the killer's spoils of the two liquidations in 34031836/34031837, collected by the stop; the 34031082 collect paid 0.
fees_note: fee = the gas token's Transfer at log 0 (sender -> fee collector, the prepayment, which is gas_limit x 2,500,000 + 1 wei on every receipt here) minus its Transfer at the last log (fee collector -> sender, the refund), computed by hand from the raw JSON. A reverted receipt carries no logs: null. Three receipts move the gas token for their own reasons between the two legs: the deposit (34031247: owner -> the portal's token holder 0x80fc..., 50,000,000,000,000 wei at log 1), the claim (the token holder -> the signer, 90,000,000,000,000 wei at log 9), and the approve (token_eth_34031245: a call on the gas token itself, an Approval at log 1).
